items.title: Caterpillar (CAT) Faces Rare Earth Squeeze As China Export Curbs Reset Supply Chains
items.summary: Beijing has introduced new export restrictions on certain rare earth materials used in high performance magnets. U.S. policymakers and manufacturers are accelerating efforts to build a domestic rare earth and magnet supply chain in response. Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) could be directly affected because advanced equipment relies on rare earth components for motors, sensors, and control systems.
